t.zh: 先把每个 ¬ 换成「→ ⊥」，再读要证的句子。
t.en: Turn every ¬ into “→ ⊥”, then read the sentence to prove.

after.zh: 反方向的 ¬¬A → A 写不出证明项：没有程序能从「A 不会不成立」变出 A 的证明。反证法要用，只能作为公理另外加上。
after.en: The other way, ¬¬A → A, has no term: no program can conjure a proof of A out of “A cannot fail”. Proof by contradiction can only come in as an axiom of its own.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

hint.zh: ¬¬下雨 是 (下雨 → ⊥) → ⊥：它是一个函数，参数本身又是一个函数。
hint.en: ¬¬it rains is (it rains → ⊥) → ⊥: a function whose argument is itself a function.

hint.zh: 拿到 a 和 b，谁能用在谁身上？b 等着一个下雨的证明。
hint.en: Given a and b, which can be used on which? b waits for a proof that it rains.

brief.zh: 用下面的块，拼出这句话的证明项。
brief.en: Build the proof term of this sentence from the pieces below.

tasks.answer: fun a b => a (fun c => c b)

hint.zh: a 等着一个「¬¬下雨」，手里的 b 证的是下雨：第一题刚造过这样的东西。
hint.en: a waits for a “¬¬it rains”, and the b in hand proves it rains: the first problem just made such a thing.
